name: persona-ref
prompt: Photographic character reference of one person, an indie Mac app founder in their late twenties: warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble, cream chunky knit sweater over a white t-shirt. Three views side by side on a plain warm light-grey studio backdrop: front facing smiling, three-quarter view, side profile. Natural soft window light, shot on 50mm, realistic skin texture, candid and friendly, not a model. No text, no logos.
